title: boutique umbrella values
description: The umbrella's own keys: one object per chart-base alias, plus the global that Helm injects. chart-base's schema checks what is under each alias; this one rejects a mistyped alias (an unknown root key would otherwise be ignored silently) and a non-boolean enabled.

component.description: A chart-base alias. Helm honors only a boolean at the condition path <alias>.enabled: a string such as "false" leaves the component in the release.
